response.sql: SELECT t.observstation AS station, o.lunarstage AS moon_phase, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM telescopes AS m WHERE m.observstation = t.observstation AND m.equipstatus = 'Maintenance') GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage ORDER BY telescope_count DESC, station, moon_phase LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Ties in telescope count are broken by station and moon phase to return exactly 10 rows.
